observations: Pi session logs contain assistant messages with plain text Qwen/llama.cpp function tags.
The assistant content did not contain Pi toolCall blocks.
The target file was not created in the mounted workspace.
Pi custom-provider docs require provider-emitted toolcall_start/toolcall_delta/toolcall_end events with a parsed toolCall block.
Pi model compatibility flags cover request-shape differences but do not convert assistant text into executable tool calls.
decision: Pi Docker is build-validated and endpoint-connected, but it is not a working local editing agent against the current llama.cpp OpenAI-compatible Qwen endpoint.
requiredToPromote: Use a provider endpoint that returns structured executable tool calls accepted by Pi.
Or implement a Pi custom provider/adapter that parses Qwen/llama.cpp function-tag text and emits Pi toolCall events.
defaultWorkflow: Use the controlled edit-agent, or the Docker-controlled edit-agent runner, for the proven local coding workflow.
